nodes.label: Money as integer cents
nodes.rationale: Amounts travel as integer cents (bigint, max 100000000000) to avoid float errors.

nodes.label: Same-domain proxy via Vercel rewrite
nodes.rationale: Browser talks only to the Vercel domain; /api/* rewrite to Render makes cookies first-party (Safari ITP), removes CORS, and APP_URL builds absolute URLs, never request headers.

nodes.label: Per-user isolation (other user's resource returns 404)
nodes.rationale: All queries filter by JWT user_id; foreign resources return 404 not 403 to avoid leaking existence.
